meta.description: In the wake of giant speculative property bubbles and high unemployment, ordinary people are occupying empty buildings in urban areas and turning them into free, open and public space. Communities thrive alongside music and art collectives, concerts, food co-operatives and community gardens. One also finds construction workshops, child care, language classes, political talks and even legal advice on social and economic rights.OkupaciÃ³nfocuses in on such community spaces in Madrid, Spain; and follows the fight to keep such spaces alive and open.
